Wide crewneck

projectContent.text: This design is a conceptual wordplay that visually references the Israeli lottery, commonly known as "Lotto." To reflect the current atmosphere in Israel, we altered the text from "Lotto" to "Lo Tov," which translates to "Not Good." This ironic twist uses the optimistic lottery logotype to convey a contrasting message. The original Israeli lottery logo was designed by Asher Kalderon in 1968 and was later updated by an unknown designer.
